title: YaSM
lead: Yet Another Service Model — a simplified, process-based ITSM framework designed for practical implementation.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: YaSM (Yet Another Service Model) is a lean ITSM framework built around a small set of end-to-end processes. It is intentionally simpler than ITIL, making it practical for small to mid-sized organisations or as a stepping stone to more comprehensive ITSM frameworks. YaSM covers the full service lifecycle from strategy to retirement.

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: YaSM is used in ITOM engagements where a lightweight process framework is needed, particularly in smaller organisations or early-stage service management implementations. Its end-to-end process view aligns with ITOM's holistic approach to service delivery.

items.desc: A small set of processes covering the complete service lifecycle.
Strategy, design, transition, operation and continual improvement.
Processes defined from the perspective of value delivered to customers.
Designed to be implementable without extensive customisation.
Can be scaled up to ITIL or other frameworks as the organisation matures.
